Dialogue_Text: "The Heroes from Icewind Dale faced many enemies before: the undead, the lizardfolk, or yeti raging in the blizzard. And while getting involved in a war between the blooming myconids and the incarnation of rot wasn't exactly the plan, that is exactly what happened. When the heroes' group decided to rest in one of the warm caves, they encountered something they never expected to see. A monstrous thing below their feet. And it wasn't alone."
A mistake many happen to make. Caves and grottos are often used by many kinds of predators.

Ah, this one is an intriguing tale, one of a group of heroes that fell into a trap. They almost became a meal for a—well, I shouldn't say too much. I suppose uncovering what the threat is may be considered part of the test. If you want to give it a try, you'll need to pay 3,500 gold pieces.
Let's see what kind of monster this might be. Here's your gold.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Right. And remember: do your best.
